The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9cf38a67706f91fa), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. statement: Suppose that one of the hypotheses of Theorem 4.1 holds. Let Ej be countably many bounded multilinear maps Ej : S × Zj,1 × · · · × Zj,rj −→ D, where the parameter spaces are separable normed spaces. Assume that Ej(S(U), Zj,1, . . . , Zj,rj ) ⊆ J(U) for every open U. Then the stabilizer may also be chosen so that, for every x ∈ S+, Ej(S(Ux), Zj,1, . . . , Zj,rj ) ⊆ IdealD(θ(x)). (4.21) The same conclusion holds for norm-continuous separably parametrized families of such maps, with local norm bounds, and for any choice of the localized multilinear input.
